headline: Keiichi Kajino's profile dates his SiTime verification-manager role to July 2023
fact: Keiichi Kajino's public professional profile dates the start of his SiTime Manager of Verification role to July 2023 and identifies him as Manager, Japan Verification. His profile separately describes mixed-signal verification experience including mixed-mode simulation, analog and digital assertions, Verilog-A/Verilog-AMS, SystemVerilog RNM, and UVM-based mixed-signal testbenches.
